description: The Data Center Knowledge Base of 451 Research, part of S&P Global Market Intelligence, covers hundreds of data points for more than 14,500 data centre facilities worldwide, including hyperscale, leased, colocation, wholesale and cryptocurrency facilities. For each site it gives location and provider headquarters, total, available and occupied IT space, IT power and rack capacity, annualised revenue, density, redundancy, certifications, expansion potential and planned construction, tenants, services, operational support and network connectivity, with current and historical company data. 451 Research analysts collect and validate the data with regular site visits and update it quarterly from the fourth quarter of 2015. Coverage: global. Format and access: a subscription product of S&P Global; MIT Libraries has bought an extract (fourth quarters 2015 to 2025) that its members can use through Harvard Dataverse. Caveats: commercial data with licence limits on redistribution; operator-reported capacities; hyperscale self-built sites are less complete. Simulation uses: an inventory of data centres with power and space capacity for grid load, hazard exposure and interdependency studies. Related records: the Virginia facility dataset and Cloudscene are other inventories; PeeringDB lists interconnection facilities.
